Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-rays demonstrate bilateral, multifocal patchy opacities with a central (perihilar) distribution and a focal consolidation in the right middle lobe (indicated by the green arrow), which are characteristic radiographic findings for Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia, particularly in immunocompromised patients. Pleural effusions are notably absent, helping to distinguish this from bacterial pneumonia or heart failure.
